original_card.question: Can a legal decoder or coframe change improve the full signed moment, including changed helper targets?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Price one complete changed itinerary with both paid and productive histograms. Check #5693/#5698 for overlap and their exact hypotheses before another coframe search. Use the signed invoice preflight where its boundary contract agrees; an inconclusive concave comparison is not a power crossing. Stop if an optimistic complete budget fails at the chosen target or native delivery remains unspecified.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

existing_checks.scope: Selected PR5599: complete helper-subspace construction and independent caller replay; five framework assumptions remain.
existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: Exact minimum monomial charge of a host of each P104 frame-indicator row (the 13 frames and the 2 excluded odd 8-cliques of the 104-by-13 witness of open PR #7014). Open question 2 of open PR #7047 (frame 0, functions of the four #7031 forms) is answered exactly; three wider named host classes (flat indicators, functions invariant under the clique's translation space, all hosts of degree at most 3) are enumerated exactly on the 120-line scope and on the 104-line scope; sparser explicit hosts from a seeded randomized search are reported as upper bounds. Charge model of #7031/#7047: monomials of degree at least 2 of the algebraic normal form in the simple-root chart, with affine terms free.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a decoder or coframe change improves the full signed moment. This package prices only the monomial-charge model that #7031 and #7047 introduced for hosting the frame-indicator rows. It prices no signed invoice, decoder or supplier, and answers open question 2 of #7047.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the P104 frame-indicator hosting bill, not a mechanism change. It lowers the recorded frame-0 charge and gives each row's charge in the #7031 model. The open question of #7048 (naming the monomials as selected-invoice primitives) is unchanged, and no kappa follows.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact census of the named classes on both scopes and the verified explicit hosts. No larger exhaustive class, no joint thirteen-row minimisation, no invoice pricing, no claim about the minimum over all Boolean functions.
evidence: research/p104-frame-host-minimum/verify.py (exhaustive, standard library, under one second): chart and quadratic-form identification of the 120 lines, coset structure of the 15 cliques, degree-3 certificates, four-form fibre census, class minima, direct evaluation of every explicit host. research/p104-frame-host-minimum/search.py regenerates data/hosts_T120.json and data/hosts_P104.json deterministically. Upper bounds from the search are finite certificates; the exact minima hold only inside the named classes.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: What is the minimum charge over all Boolean hosts of one row, not only over the named classes?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The explicit hosts of several rows (frame 5: 6, frame 12: 9, frame 7: 10) lie below every exact class minimum, so the class minima are not the true minima and no lower bound beyond degree 3 is proved.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate all hosts of degree at most 4 for the smallest rows (2^37 per row, compiled), or prove a coset-leader lower bound for excluded clique X0, whose best known charge is 7.
open_questions.blocked_by: 2^37 hosts per row is beyond the standard-library verifier, and no cheap lower-bound certificate for the 247-coordinate coset problem is known.

open_questions.question: What is the joint charge of the thirteen rows when a monomial shared between rows is charged once?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Open question 2 of #7046 asks whether shared monomials can be charged once. The per-row hosts here are chosen independently, so their union is only an upper bound for one selection.
open_questions.first_step: List the near-optimal hosts per row (the 8 invariant and the 512 cubic hosts are exactly enumerable) and minimise the union of supports by exact search over the choice of host per row.
open_questions.blocked_by: No circuit is given that realises a joint host, so the charging rule for a shared monomial is the predecessor's open point.

open_questions.question: Can the chart monomials of these hosts be named as primitives of the selected #6030 invoice?
open_questions.why_it_matters: #7048 records that the 40 frame-0 monomials are not invoice primitives, so no kappa change follows from any charge in this model until a map to the invoice alphabet exists.
open_questions.first_step: Make one constructor of the selected invoice read one monomial exponent and check the image of all monomials of the frame-0 host of charge 14.
open_questions.blocked_by: The present constructors read frame dimensions, idle lengths and a diagonal popcount only, as #7048 records.
